summary.zh: 将 shared/*.cjs 从 CLI 的 ESM bundle 中外部化，修复 hana --help 因 esbuild CJS->ESM shim 无法处理裸 require("crypto") 而崩溃的问题。
summary.en: Externalize shared/*.cjs from the CLI ESM bundle so hana --help stops crashing on esbuild's CJS->ESM shim throwing on bare require('crypto').

title.zh: hana CLI 外部化 shared/*.cjs，--help 退出码归零
title.en: hana CLI externalizes shared/*.cjs so --help exits 0

summary.zh: cli/data.ts ESM 导入 shared/data-epoch.cjs，esbuild 将其内联进 ESM bundle，但 data-epoch.cjs 的裸 require('crypto'/'fs'/'path') 在 ESM shim 中抛出 'Dynamic require of crypto is not supported'。.6 补齐 JSON 后该问题暴露。将 data-epoch.cjs、contract-versions.cjs、server-info-probe.cjs 标记为 --external，改由 Node 原生 CJS 加载器在运行时解析，并将前两者打入 shared/ 目录。
summary.en: cli/data.ts ESM-imports shared/data-epoch.cjs, which esbuild inlines into the ESM bundle; data-epoch.cjs's bare require('crypto'/'fs'/'path') then throws inside esbuild's CJS->ESM shim. Surfaced once .6 shipped contract-versions.json. Fix: mark data-epoch.cjs, contract-versions.cjs, and server-info-probe.cjs as --external so Node's native CJS loader handles them at runtime, and stage data-epoch.cjs + server-info-probe.cjs into shared/.

sources.title: fix(server): externalize shared/*.cjs from CLI bundle so hana --help exits 0
